quote: We refer to this body of work as Automatic Leaderboard Generation (ALG): "A systematic process for extracting relevant experimental findings from scientific publications to create and maintain a leaderboard."
We recommend that researchers report precision, recall, and F1 as both micro and macro scores... leaderboard recall (LR), paper coverage (PC), result coverage (RC), and average overlap (AO).
We recommend that researchers report precision, recall, and F1 as both micro and macro scores ...
Most work reports micro precision, recall, and F1, either for exact tuple matches or per entity class (e.g., task, metric).
For SciLead, the leaderboard tuples ⟨task, dataset, metric, score⟩ were fully annotated by a single human annotator, prioritising quality but limiting dataset size due to the manual effort involved.
guideline: The paper highlights SciLead as valuable for its fully human-curated annotations, ensuring high quality, and recommends it for benchmarking.
